goal: Query historical transaction outputs and spenders by address, script hash, or descriptor via RPC
Avoids running heavy external indexing stacks for wallet servers and external tools
reviewability: Ready for review, with no known blockers or pending rebases
agreement: Strong support with multiple tested ACKs and broad concept approval
Verified by testing index layout, prefix collisions, and pruned sync (kravens, ViniciusCestarii)
Earlier objections around disk budgets and library boundaries were resolved (kravens)
Minor open suggestions on sync checks and unspendable outputs (kravens, ViniciusCestarii)
